summary: Improve scenario design, alert triage and investigation records with practical AML exercises. Explore the course and strengthen your monitoring workflow.
lede: AML transaction monitoring training helps teams turn payment activity into documented scenarios, consistent alert decisions and traceable case outcomes. For AML analysts, investigators, compliance officers and MLROs, it develops practical methods for building risk-based scenario inventories, prioritising alerts and recording investigation evidence. Exercises also cover suspicious-transaction decision records, typology updates and quality checks using case materials and spreadsheet-based analysis; advanced analytics and model validation receive overview-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with transaction-monitoring alerts, AML investigations or related control reviews and need stronger operational methods.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of AML controls and familiarity with transaction-monitoring alerts, KYC records or financial-crime case handling. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
